title: Screen Landmark Lens
user: A blind or low-vision worker using remote desktops, legacy apps, or inaccessible job software who needs to find and activate a visible control without accessibility metadata.
smallest_useful_product: A desktop app that captures only a user-selected window, runs local OCR, and offers keyboard shortcuts for read visible labels, find text, and describe likely buttons with a simple directional cue.
success_measure: In five scripted inaccessible-app tasks, a pilot user finds the requested labeled control unaided in at least four tasks.
constraints: Process captures locally, require an explicitly selected window, disclose uncertainty, and never represent output as professional or medical advice.
